name: agy
description: Antigravity CLI (agy / Gemini) inside Claude Code, on your Google AI Pro subscription: media (audio, video, images), web research, documents, a local NotebookLM, site scraping and design review, plus delegation of bulk work. Merged from yuting0624/antigravity-for-claude-code (engine) and MarcosNahuel/antigravity-plugin-cc (features); Gemini gets narrow permissions, never blanket auto-approve unless asked.

default_tier.title: Default Antigravity tier
default_tier.description: flash (default, bulk work), flash-lo (cheapest), pro (hard reasoning, media)

timeout.title: Default delegation timeout
timeout.description: agy print-mode timeout when --timeout is not passed, e.g. 5m, 10m

default_model.title: Default executor model (exact agy model name)
default_model.description: Empty uses the tier mapping. Set with /agy:model.
